mapper.sql: CARD_ID, USE_COUNT, CHANNEL, CODE_STATUS, GATE_IN_TIME, GATE_IN_STATION, LAST_TXN_TIME, LAST_TXN_STATION, TXN_SEQ, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, GATE_STATUS
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO QRCODE_STATUS T USING ( SELECT #{cardId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CARD_ID, #{useCount,jdbcType=INTEGER} AS USE_COUNT, #{channel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CHANNEL, #{codeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CODE_STATUS, #{gateInTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS GATE_IN_TIME, #{gateInStation,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS GATE_IN_STATION, #{lastTxnTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS LAST_TXN_TIME, #{lastTxnStation,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS LAST_TXN_STATION, #{txnSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TXN_SEQ, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AS CREATE_TIME, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AS UPDATE_TIME, #{gateStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS GATE_STATUS FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.CARD_ID = S.CARD_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.USE_COUNT = S.USE_COUNT, T.CHANNEL = S.CHANNEL, T.CODE_STATUS = S.CODE_STATUS, T.GATE_IN_TIME = S.GATE_IN_TIME, T.GATE_IN_STATION = S.GATE_IN_STATION, T.LAST_TXN_TIME = S.LAST_TXN_TIME, T.LAST_TXN_STATION = S.LAST_TXN_STATION, T.TXN_SEQ = S.TXN_SEQ, T.UPDATE_TIME = S.UPDATE_TIME, T.GATE_STATUS = S.GATE_STATUS WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( CARD_ID, USE_COUNT, CHANNEL, CODE_STATUS, GATE_IN_TIME, GATE_IN_STATION, LAST_TXN_TIME, LAST_TXN_STATION, TXN_SEQ, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, GATE_STATUS ) VALUES ( S.CARD_ID, S.USE_COUNT, S.CHANNEL, S.CODE_STATUS, S.GATE_IN_TIME, S.GATE_IN_STATION, S.LAST_TXN_TIME, S.LAST_TXN_STATION, S.TXN_SEQ, S.CREATE_TIME, S.UPDATE_TIME, S.GATE_STATUS )
